QUOTE: So a composite code such as `-(high | low)` comes out as `"MODULE - high text : low text"`. A code with only low bits gets only the low-level text.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a code splits into high-level (module) and low-level parts, and that `mbedtls_strerror` renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
